review_scope: 独立审查 r04 隔离候选能否作为新的 S15 正式工具包；不批准生产 prepare、Vivado、资源准入、bitgen 或板级验收。

formal_copy.copy_check: 13/13 copied tool SHA256 values equal the reviewed candidate manifest

independent_checks: 13/13 candidate and formal baseline tool hashes match the manifest; declared change set matches.
13/13 evidence index artifact sizes and hashes match.
Both exact-path APIs reject raw dot and dot-dot components before Path normalization; canonical paths pass.
UNC, device namespace, drive-relative, root-relative, wildcard and junction reparse paths fail closed.
Win32 path API handle fallback passes an accessible canonical leaf and rejects wrong case and junctions; inaccessible C:\Users fallback returns access denied and fails closed.
Interpreter path and SHA are fixed; config tests reject replacement and resource-threshold overrides.
DETACHED_PROCESS retains explicit stdout/stderr redirection; supervisor, guard and resource thresholds are unchanged.
limitations: Windows symlink creation was unavailable with WinError 1314; junction reparse points were tested and rejected.
POSIX path behavior was not validated.
One malformed JSON inherited from the prior r03 failed experiment is preserved byte-for-byte; the replacement r04 result and final evidence index are valid and hash-bound.
Continuous OS process-tree/resource monitoring, Vivado bitgen, XSA/Vitis application package and board tests remain unrun.
